facts.statement: Farnum Farm hosts a yearly community party honoring the land that grows Free Realms' food; players dance, harvest, play games and visit friends.
facts.quote: Every year Farnum Farm hosts a party honoring the land that grows the food for Free Realms.

facts.statement: The U.S. and Latin America session was on Thursday April 22, 2010 at 3pm Pacific Time on Server 1.
facts.quote: Thursday April 22nd, 2010 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: The UK and Europe session was on Friday April 23, 2010 at 9:00am Pacific Time (4:00pm GMT) on Server 1.
facts.quote: Friday April 23rd, 2010 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Community Event: Farnum's Love The Land Party
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com 'What is New?' post announcing a community party at Farnum Farm, held on Server 1 on April 22, 2010 (US/Latin America) and April 23, 2010 (UK/Europe). The party invites players to dance, harvest, play games and wear farming clothes, and explains how to find community events via the Game Guide calendar and GO button.
